items.title: Lawrence Duhé Interview, 1957-06-09
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Sam was pretty good there. [INTERVIEWEE] I knew Mutt very well. Wonderful trumpet playing. His style of playing.

ctx.x: You better turn it off for a second.
Mutt Cherry died up there, too. Yes, he died in 1948, I think, September of 1948. Sam was pretty good there.
I knew Mutt very well. Wonderful trumpet playing. His style of playing.
